sources.claim: Kikunoi Honten — phone booking required

sources.claim: Website booking, 3+ days notice, private rooms only

sources.claim: Gion Sasaki ¥54,000 dinner; 16+ year wait by regulars

sources.claim: Mizai near-impossible even 18 months out; ¥60,000 cash only

sources.title: Miyamaso official site
sources.claim: Miyamaso 1h40m by bus, fully booked 1+ year out; ¥28–34k dinner

sources.claim: Hyotei ¥25,000–35,000; midnight JST slot release 90 days ahead

sources.claim: Kikunoi ¥47,500–74,000; phone booking; 3rd-gen chef Yoshihiro Murata

sources.title: Philosopher's Path (Japan Guide)
sources.claim: ~2 km canal-side walk from Ginkaku-ji to Nanzen-ji

sources.title: Fushimi Inari guide (Lions in the Piazza)
sources.claim: Arrive before 8am for empty torii tunnels

sources.claim: Humidity 72–86% in June, peak moss and bamboo greenness

sources.claim: Gion private alley ban since May 2024; ¥10,000 fine

sources.title: Bus pass retirement (Time Out)
sources.claim: ¥700 city bus day pass retired March 2024

sources.claim: ¥1,100 Subway & Bus 1-Day Pass; ¥500 EX100/EX101 express buses weekends

sources.claim: Up to ¥10,000/person/night accommodation tax from March 1, 2026

sources.title: WCAI-2026 Osaka
sources.claim: 4th World Congress of AI Industry, Jun 16–18, Osaka (30 min by shinkansen)

sources.title: IVS 2026
sources.claim: IVS2026 Jul 1–3, 13,000+ attendees, Japan's largest startup summit

sources.title: BitSummit PUNCH
sources.claim: BitSummit PUNCH May 22–24, Japan's largest indie gaming festival

sources.title: Kyoto Tech Meetup
sources.claim: Saturday 9:30am at Starbucks Kyoto Nishikikoji; free beyond a drink

sources.title: Fushimi Inari access (Japan Guide)
sources.claim: Free, always open; JR Inari Station 5 min from Kyoto Station

sources.title: Kiyomizu-dera guide (ObjetPark)
sources.claim: Opens 6am, ¥400 entry; arrive 6–8am for crowd-free terrace

sources.title: Arashiyama bamboo guide (Japanichiban)
sources.claim: Before 8am: empty path, morning light, famous rustling sound

sources.title: Philosopher's Path guide (Quinnie's Odyssey)
sources.claim: Honen-in (free, mossy thatched gate) is the standout less-obvious stop

sources.title: Ippodo Tea Kyoto store (official)
sources.claim: Kaboku Tearoom 10:00–17:00; closed 2nd Wednesdays; no reservations

sources.title: Kinkaku-ji access (official)
sources.claim: Opens 9:00–17:00 daily; ¥500 adults, cash only

sources.title: Ryoan-ji guide (InsideKyoto)
sources.claim: Opens 8:00–17:00 (Mar–Nov); ¥600 adults; 15-stone dry garden

sources.title: Kikunoi Honten on TABLEALL
sources.claim: Dinner B ¥47,500 / Dinner C ¥60,500 / Special ¥74,000

sources.title: Kyoto yudofu guide (Leaf Kyoto)
sources.claim: Yudofu Sagano ¥4,400 set; 5-min walk from Togetsukyo

sources.title: Arashiyama guide (InsideKyoto)
sources.claim: Enter via Tenryu-ji north gate to skip worst crowds

sources.title: Nishiki Market (Japan Guide)
sources.claim: Five-block covered street with 100+ shops; no eating while walking

sources.title: Kagizen Yoshifusa guide (Champ Magazine)
sources.claim: Founded early 1700s; famous kuzukiri arrowroot noodles and kikujuto sweets

sources.title: Pontocho guide (Magical Trip)
sources.claim: 500m lane; 6–9pm sweet spot for lanterns and maiko sightings
